csatGrade.title: CSAT Grade Calculator
csatGrade.description: Estimate Korean, Math and Inquiry grades using 2026 academic-year reference cutoffs; calculate English and Korean History using absolute grading rules.
csatGrade.subject: Select Subject
csatGrade.disclaimer: The Korean, Math and Inquiry tables are 2026 academic-year reference data. Use the official KICE score report for actual 2027 grades, standard scores and percentiles. Estimated raw-score cutoffs are distinct from official standard-score grade boundaries.

grading.title: Grading Method
items: Korean, Math and Inquiry use relative grading based on standard scores. Nominal cumulative bands are 4, 11, 23, 40, 60, 77, 89, 96 and 100%; ties can make actual proportions differ.
Korean and Math standard scores involve adjusting elective scores using the common section. A total raw score alone cannot determine an official standard score or grade.
English is graded absolutely out of 100. Grade 1 starts at 90, Grade 2 at 80, and boundaries decrease by 10 points; below 20 is Grade 9. No standard score or percentile is reported.

Korean History is graded absolutely out of 50. Grade 1 starts at 40, Grade 2 at 35, and boundaries decrease by 5 points; below 5 is Grade 9. Students who do not take Korean History receive no CSAT score report.

For the 2027 exam, up to two of 17 Social Studies/Science subjects may be selected. This calculator uses a previous-year reference table for each chosen subject, not one overall Social Studies/Science average.

tips.title: Notes
items: The 2026 academic-year CSAT was held in 2025. The 2027 academic-year exam is on November 19, 2026, and is distinct from this calculator's relative-grading reference data.
Distinguish estimated raw cutoffs from official standard-score grade boundaries. English and Korean History score reports show only absolute grades based on raw scores.

Standard-score and percentile estimates are simple interpolations between previous-year reference points. Actual percentiles depend on the score distribution; do not treat these estimates as official conversions.
Required areas, best-one versus average-of-two Inquiry rules, rounding and Korean History conditions vary by university and program.
Admissions score measures and converted Inquiry scores also vary by university. Use the official KICE score report and the relevant university's admission guide for final decisions.

whatIs.title: What is the CSAT Grade Calculator?
whatIs.description: This tool calculates reference grades and grade sums from raw scores. It displays the 2027 academic-year schedule but uses 2026 reference raw-score estimates for Korean, Math and Inquiry. English and Korean History use 2027 absolute grading rules. It does not predict this year's relative grades or decide university-specific minimum requirements.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Select your Korean/Math electives and the specific Inquiry subjects you take.
2. Enter raw scores and check the estimate or absolute-grading label on each result.
3. The average adds Korean, Math, English and the mean of both Inquiry grades, then divides by four. Korean History is excluded.

4. The reference grade sum uses the better Inquiry subject. Compare with your entered limit, then separately check required areas, Inquiry rules and Korean History conditions in the university's admission guide.
5. Shared images and text include the reference year and estimate labels. Links restore selected subjects, scores and the grade-sum settings.

items.q: Are these predicted grades for the 2027 academic-year CSAT?
items.a: Korean, Math and Inquiry results apply 2026 reference cutoffs. The calculator does not include 2027 cutoffs, so they cannot be read as this year's actual grades. English and Korean History use 2027 absolute raw-score rules.

items.q: When are the 2027 exam and score reports?
items.a: The exam is on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and score reports are issued on Friday, December 11, 2026. See the official Ministry of Education schedule linked below.

items.q: Can equal raw scores yield different standard scores or grades?
items.a: Yes. Korean and Math involve common-section/elective adjustments, while relative grades depend on that exam's score distribution. This tool's simple interpolation by total score does not reproduce official scoring.

items.q: Does a sum within the entered limit mean I meet the minimum requirement?
items.a: This reference calculation adds the best areas among Korean, Math, English and your better Inquiry subject. It includes relative-grade estimates and omits university-specific required areas, Inquiry averaging/rounding and Korean History rules. Check actual eligibility against your official results and the admission guide.

items.q: How does Inquiry count in the average and grade sum?
items.a: The average treats the mean of both Inquiry grades as one area. The reference minimum-requirement sum treats the better Inquiry grade as one area. Both exclude Korean History and may differ from a university's formula.

items.q: What happens exactly at a reference cutoff?
items.a: This calculator assigns the listed grade at or above the table's raw-score boundary. Relative-grade boundaries are reference estimates and do not guarantee this year's actual boundary. English and Korean History follow the official absolute-grading bands.

records.title: My score records
records.description: Name and save up to {max} sets of raw scores and electives for comparison. Records stay in this browser.
records.localHint: Saved records never replace inputs automatically. Select a record to compare, then confirm loading it to change your inputs.
records.sharedHint: Inputs from the shared URL are restored first. Saved records are not applied automatically.

records.name: Score record name (up to 40 characters)
records.savedBasis: Basis when saved: {exam} exam year / {reference} relative-grading reference year
records.differentYear: The saved and current academic-year bases differ. Only raw scores are compared. Loading recalculates grades using this calculator's current reference data.
records.comparisonNote: The difference is the current raw score minus the saved raw score, only for matching electives. It does not adjust for exam difficulty or determine academic improvement.
records.sharedRestore: Loading also replaces the current scores and electives restored from the shared URL.

reasons.differentSubject: Electives differ, so no score difference is calculated.
reasons.missingScore: A score is missing, so no difference is calculated. Blank is distinct from zero.
reasons.invalidScore: An input is invalid, so no difference is calculated.

confirm.saveBody: Save raw scores, electives and the current academic-year basis as “{name}”. Blank inputs remain blank.
confirm.loadBody: Replace current raw scores and electives with “{name}”. Grades will be recalculated using the calculator's current reference data. Cancel and record your current inputs first if you want to keep them.
confirm.deleteBody: Delete “{name}” from this browser. Current inputs will remain.

errors.unavailable: Browser storage could not be accessed. Success cannot be confirmed. Check your browser settings and reload the list.
errors.quota: Browser storage is full. Free some space, reload the list, then try saving again.
errors.conflict: Another tab or operation changed the saved list. It was not overwritten. Reload the list and select your action again.
errors.unverified: The result could not be verified after writing. The change may already be stored and rollback is not guaranteed. Reload the list before saving again.
errors.invalid: Scores must be blank or whole numbers within the maximum (0–100 for Korean, Math and English; 0–50 for History and Inquiry). Check your electives and inputs.
errors.name: Enter 1–40 characters after trimming surrounding spaces. Control characters are not allowed.
errors.limit: You can keep up to 12 records. Review and delete an existing record before saving another.
errors.missing: The selected record is no longer in the list. Reload saved records.
errors.stale: Current inputs changed during confirmation, so the action was canceled. Check the latest inputs and select your action again.

directGrades.basis: Based on grades entered by you
directGrades.description: Enter grades you know to compare the same goals saved above. Reference raw-score cutoffs are not used to estimate these grades, and this feature does not verify them as official results.
directGrades.scope: Direct inputs last only while you use this page. They are excluded from existing raw-score inputs, the 12 saved records, shared links and share cards. No standard scores, percentiles or averages are generated.
directGrades.rule: Korean, Math, English and the better inquiry subject each count as one area. Areas with lower grade numbers are added first. University-specific required areas, inquiry averages, Korean History requirements and admission decisions are not applied.
